figures.caption: Table 1: NDCG@500 Uplift for LTE integration strategies.

Figure 1: Statistical consistency of LTE attention migration. The delta (LTE - baseline) is computed after normalizing attention weights within themost recent 50 interactions to a local share of 1.0. The model appears to moderate mid-session fluctuations to reclaim attention share for older history. Gray bands indicate the 95% confidence interval calculated across the holdout set.
